liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Fire On The Mountain** (6 reviews): Jerry tweaked notes using a bank of wah pedals on his cabinet, producing odd space-like sounds mid-song; Jerry's outer-space guitar sounds, with the Space Needle overhead, made an interesting moment [8][10][14][15][17][18]
- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Beautiful and haunting, with Jerry wailing at length at the end, sounding tearful; Recommended as one of the hottest versions ever, alongside Fire [10][14]

## The recordings

- **gd95-05-26.sbd.2663.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 17 songs; 156 min; rated 4.03/5 by 39 [1]. Said about its sound: Clarity falls short of other 1990s digital soundboards; bass is muddy and levels are off; Recording sounds muffled, like listening with wax in the ears; better sources exist for 1960s shows [11][13]
- **gd1995-05-26.sbd.larson.35169.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 156 min; rated 3.44/5 by 9 [2]
- **gd1995-05-26.pzm.russjcan.97643.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 161 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1995-05-26.schoeps.unknown.larson.35199.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 163 min [4]

## Around the show

- The weather was gorgeous [10]
- Reviewer lives in Seattle, attended the run, and was blown away by the second set [17]
- Reviewer calls the soundboard the best-sounding one they have heard from 1995 [8]
- Of the three nights, Friday was otherworldly at times, with a smoking start to the second set [16]
- Reviewer thinks it is probably the band's last great show and that '95 material is mostly weak [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd95-05-26.sbd.2663.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > Cass/1 > DAT > Montego II S/PDIF > CDWav > SHNv3 [1]. Also: Reviewer suspects azimuth was poorly adjusted during the cassette transfer and hopes a better source appears [11]
- **gd1995-05-26.sbd.larson.35169.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: S:D>C [2]
- **gd1995-05-26.pzm.russjcan.97643.flac16**: taped by Russ Cansler; transferred by Russ Cansler; source: Hat mounted realistic PZM's w/Sony D6-c,50ft dfc > Master [3]
- **gd1995-05-26.schoeps.unknown.larson.35199.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: Af:D4 Schoeps CMC + MK21>DAT(48kHz) [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1995-05-25 Memorial Stadium, Seattle, WA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1995-05-25-memorial-stadium-seattle-wa-usa/) [21]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Scarlet>Fire, GD_1995-05-26](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/scarlet-fire-gd-1995-05-26) [22]
